Insanely well made game. 10/10 characters, art, and storyline. Before you keep reading into this game, avoid spoilers. Game is an absolute master piece and one of the best horror games i've ever played in my life.

This is a really good game, with beautiful animation and scenes. The plot is very enjoyable, and the atmospheric horror aspects of it really dont miss. My only issue with the game is the slightly weird controls, and that one unecessary graveyard scene with swansea. Other than that, I highly recommend this game for psychological horror lovers.
Short story. FInished in one sitting. Interesting plot and characters. Excellent visuals. Overall 10/10 experience.
This entire game is what its like to try and get water at 2:30 in the morning with a fever.
Highly recommended game featuring horses, encouragement to treat your mental and dental care seriously, and a great message on checking in on your friends when they're going through rough times.

Mouthwashing is a genuinely unsettling and surreal experience. A delightfully crunchy aesthetic paired with well written dialogue, eerie sound design, and a great narrative. I don't want to spoil too much about it, so I'll keep it brief, but if a horrific and dreary adventure game/walking sim is up your alley, this will satisfy completely. Wholeheartedly recommended.

Amazing of a ride, the game sections elevated the intensity, but weren't impossible, only felt like it or atleast gave a huge level of anxiety.

Loved this.
One of the best psychological horror game i've ever played the story is so *muah*

Incredible game. One of my favorite premises of a group of people stranded. I wish I could say more, but it'd be in the spoiler territory. To put it short, in my opinion, it is Psych Horror perfected.

My original thought going into this game was "Hey, its a new horror game. Perfect for the Halloween spirit!"
I was expecting this game to be like every other game that's suppose to be scary with cheap jump scares and a overall silly plot about how the Mouthwash is evil and will burn you alive (AHHHHHHH).
This game past all expectation.
The plot: AMAZING
The jump scares: Very well timed (I actually jumped at one part)
The puzzles: Not too difficult and yet not too simple
I just can't put into words how my expectations were blown away, I cannot wait for another game to be produced by this company.
Hope you have a nice day :)

First off, I barely ever write reviews. I received this game for free and, after going in blind, I was blown away.

Reminiscent of early PS1 survival horror. Felt like Dead-Space without guns meets Silent Hill 1. Very eerie atmosphere, great story, unique graphics, on-the-edge-of-your-seat horror, the perfect amount of jumpscares, all wrapped up in a "what the fuck happened?" space mystery. This game was amazing. 10/10, look forward to seeing more from this studio.

This game is AWESOME. creepy, with just enough horror to keep you on your toes, but not so hard that my (easily scared) self couldn't play. Lots of unsettling imagery, well-crafted challenges, and overall an AWESOME game!

Funny how a $12.99 game can have more of a profound narrative than a AAA game.

This is more of a thought provoking art piece, it was worth the play.

Surprisingly coming into this i already knew it would be good, Wrong Organ did so much with How Fish Is Made (even though it was a free game), that you just knew they would do a great game once again.
Overall gameplay is nice, everything feels right, controls are not clunky, no performance issues, everything just works.
The overall setting of the game is cohesive and does a good job with its story telling, this really feels like watching a Tarantino movie, few characters, one setting and jumping back and forward in timelines.
The completion side of it is more comical than trying to be scary, which is really great to take out the dread of the story itself.
Although the game itself is short, it does a really good job with the atmosphere and psychological horror elements of it .
Must buy game if it is on sale!

What can I say? It's smart, creatively presented, thematically heavy, even brutal. It's exactly as long as it needs to be, perfectly paced, looks amazing, has pathos. Takes turns being funny, sad, scary. It achieves a *lot* in a very limited scope.

It's a 10/10, dude.

They sentenced me to several hours of boredom. Watch "Solaris" by Andrei Tarkovsky if you haven't done it yet. It will be much better gameplay with so much better story. Though, there are nice PSx-era aesthetics and vibe in the game, so if you feel the nostalgia, you might give it a try, just don't expect too much of it.
i hate this game so much for the feeling it left me with. i want to play this game for the first time again. 10/10

I really enjoyed this game even though it is short. The atmosphere and visuals are incredible. The alternation between past and present events is very well done, and makes for an interesting story. Mouthwashing is a nice little gem.

Amazing game. Loved it from start to finish. You'll get about 2 - 3 hours out of it but in my opinion that's better than overstaying it's welcome. Very tight polished experience I'll probably dust off every now and again.
It's a refreshing experience. I would say the horror elements are far from perfect, but the narrative and atmosphere make it a great game regardless.

I just finished this game and I am still shocked by the feelings I experienced while playing this game, I was planning to buy this game for a few months and I am glad I did. I don't really know how to process my emotions about what I just experienced. I could probably write a 300 word essay about all the characters and theme of the game.

If you have played games like silent hill 2, SOMA etc. you would love this game,Although its more "to the face" than SH2 I feel I can compare the bleakness of the two. The emotions u feel as you finish this game and put all the pieces together are masterfully done.

Although the game is short and you can finish it in 3-5 hours, it has established a very high place on my list of favorite games.Now that I have finished this game, I am gonna bother everyone I know to play this so they can experience what I did and hear there thoughts on the overall story and characters.

If you are reading this review then go in for a blind playthrough and trust me it can be one of the best experience you wIll ever have.

This is a fantastic game. The low poly graphics add a lot, allowing a level of violence and horror that might otherwise appear cheesy with higher fidelity graphics. I love the story and it handles the themes it presents incredibly well. I won't say any more because it truly is a game you should experience for yourself (though mind the content warnings).
It is a very linear game with not a whole lot of game play, so the replay value isn't too high. There's also some sections where it's extremely unclear what you're supposed to be doing which can be frustrating. Besides those two little things, I don't have any complaints!

im playing it while im on my period, but holyshit dawg this game is really amazing. at first i was confused how they told the narrative since i was believing that curly is the one who are the crazy one that is why he got air fried. but no. hes actually the sane one. but because hes a people pleaser that is why. and i hate jimmy like i hate micah in rdr2 i have burning hate for this crazy ass man. like dawg if youre not on that ship. curly, anya, swansea, and my baby daisuke could stay alive until the expedition completed.

A fantastic little horror story! With the widespread success and popularity this game has garnered through youtube, I really hope that there are more things like this produced soon. The genre of the short, self contained horror experience is ALIVE, and games like Iron Lung and Mouthwashing have resuscitated them
One of the best story driven games I have had the chance to play. Set some time aside and play beginning to end. 10/10.

Mouthwashing is definitely not a game for every horror fan. It’s lowkey slow, and it requires some mental work to keep up with the story. If u’re looking for fast and straightforward horror, Mouthwashing probably isn’t for u.

But for me, it will always remian one of my favs.
The story is layered and disturbing. The art style and atmosphere feel attracts me and keeps me hooked

it’s confusing at times and feels mentally exhausting. But that’s part of the experience. It’s not supposed to be comfortable.

It’s my personal cup of tea because I like stories that feel heavy and meaningful.

I think this is most disturbing games I've ever played, although I haven't played many horror games. The game switches back and forth from months before and after, while they can be a little hard to understand at times but you always figure it soon after. Knowing what to do and where to go can be hard at times but thanks to the small map and just using your head you figure it out easily. I didn't know much about this game when I got it but boy is this good stuff, the tell a good story and how they piece it together with flashbacks from the past then back to present is great. The characters are also amasing, there's so much detail put into these characters. Some people who seem like horrible people become the most human of all. I greatly recommend.

This game is a criminally amazing game, the psychological horror, story telling if you get it, and piece it together is just a masterpiece. You can watch gameplay of it, but I'd say you gotta at least try it yourself for the best experience.
5⭐/5⭐
Wow, this game has a lot of really likeable and in-depth characters! I sure do hope that nothing bad happens to any of them!
This was mostly just disturbing torture porn im not gonna lie. Some good story/characters stuff tho, but I cant recommend this anyone even horror fans. Incredible presentation

Utterly excellent game , masterpiece , work of art , no game has made me feel such strong emotion and connection to the characters as Mouthwashing has , goes to show how indie games with true passion behind them are true GOLD. 15/10 game , You need to experience this work of art.
Excellent mind trip. It reminds me of Inscryption. the music is terrific. top tier immersion.
Couldn't tell if my pc was lagging or I was tripping balls. 10/10. Takes about 3 hours to beat but was really worth the experience =)

I don't think I have ever written a serious review to recommend a game, but today is the day that changes because I have nothing more to say aside from "PLEASE GO PLAY THIS GAME, AND YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT."

I went in blind because I was buying a different game on the Steam store page, but then I saw "Mouthwashing" recommended. It looked kinda silly because I thought, "What kinda name is 'Mouthwashing'?" I barely read the description but was convinced by the soundtrack, artistic style, and PSX graphics in the trailer to buy the game. After all, it was $13 USD. That's less expensive than a mediocre meal from a mediocre fast food chain that I will buy and regret anyway, so what's the worst that could happen? The overwhelmingly positive reviews also got my attention because it's really rare to see PC gamers ever be happy about anything, LOL.

All I'm saying is that I am so glad that I came across this game because it is something that lingers in the back of my mind at all times ever since I finished the game. The story, characters, symbolism, etc., is just amazing.

GO PLAY MOUTHWASHING NOW! And I hope this hurts.
I would like to formally apologize to the name Jimmy after playing this game. The Jim in this game is not like you. We hate Jimwashing Guy.

a true horror story about humanity. its a short game with amazing writing and visual storytelling, its got a special place in my heart. i could talk about it for hours but its best to go in blind and experience it for yourself
It's a great story that can be applied to many aspects of life, featuring a brilliant art style. However, it's a bit too short for me and lacks deeper game mechanics.

Good but short. A few gory sections and jump scares but mainly the horror element is from atmosphere and weirdness. Strong art style, reminds me of PS1 games. Very short though, completed in 3.2 hours and don't really feel any need to replay. I think some reviews overblow how crazy or mindbending the story is but it was well done enough and held my attention. Recommend if you want a short narrative psychological horror game.

Demented ass game, in the best way possible. It relies on countless metaphors, implications and subtleties to really get the story across, which is its biggest strength, and while I got the general gist, there must be more details that must've flown over my head that I need to go back and properly assess it.

The dithered low polygonal PS1 aesthetic, soundtrack and sound design lend themselves strongly to portraying much of the tone, and the art direction exacerbates it even further by not being afraid and really getting surreal to intensify the horror of the whole scenario, which I loved.

I can't wait to see this team cook more.

I didn't know what to expect when I played Mouthwashing. I saw bits of the trailer that showed interesting surreal visual setpieces and decided to give it a go.

What I got was a very well written slow burn story. The type that reveals further details when you play a second time. Foreshadowing you couldn't get the first time because you didn't know as much.

I'm being vague because it is better experienced as blind as possible.

It's short for a game but it's like playing a very good movie. Totally worth it.
Yo play this game worth every dollar. This game got a better story than most triple A games

I wasn't expecting this game to leave such a heavy mark on me the first time I saw it, but it hit me as a terrifying mirror held up to ego, control, and the catastrophic damage caused by someone who refuses to take accountability. It made me realize the real horror of someone burning down every life around them, and forced me to look in the mirror at the ways I might be doing the same thing.

I will always love every decision made, design, sound, and narrative wise. It is a fantastic experience. I could compare it to an A24 movie, but like a really good one that changes your life at 3am.

It's a game that will stick with me forever.

One of the best narrative games I’ve ever played.

The juxtaposition with Curly and Jimmy where you play with one and then the other, piecing together what happened and finally realizing what really happened just to be left disgusted by Jimmy, is brilliant.

9/10 It’s a really good game. I recommend it.
Great and short game, best advice is to go into this game as blind as you can.
